stayType: Holiday park with caravans, glamping and touring pitches
accommodation: Caravans from budget to platinum grades, a farmhouse, camping and touring pitches, two-bedroom camping pods and two-bedroom safari tents (Visit Cornwall listing).
suitableFor: Families with children, campers and tourers, groups wanting on-site entertainment.
parking: Parking listed as a facility (Visit Cornwall); two EV charging points (operator).
dogs: Pets welcome in designated areas of the restaurant and takeaway; full accommodation dog policy not stated.
beachAccess: Less than a mile from the beach; guests can walk down to Widemouth Bay.
confirmedFeatures: indoor heated pool, bar, Drifters restaurant and takeaway, shop, launderette, Wi-Fi in clubhouse, EV charging, kids' club, play area, crazy golf, 5-a-side pitch, amusements, bingo and cabaret, water zorbs, woodland walk
overview: A large John Fowler Holidays park set in 50 acres of countryside above Widemouth Bay, south of Bude. It mixes graded static caravans, glamping pods, safari tents and touring pitches with a clubhouse, indoor pool and evening entertainment, and guests can walk down to the beach in under a mile.
surfTripFit: Walking distance to Widemouth Bay and cheap-to-mid accommodation make it workable for surf families, though it is entertainment-led and no board storage or outdoor showers are mentioned.
gaps: Accommodation types taken from Visit Cornwall, not the operator page. Dog policy for units, unit counts and board storage not stated.
